newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures jump but initial resistance holds.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures jump but initial resistance holds.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures followed up Monday's firmer trend with early trade and fund short-covering boosting both markets, but resistance levels were intact after the initial surge, traders said.
At 1035 GMT the August Brent contract stood 19 cents up at $18.70 after touching off initial resistance at $18.77 a barrel. July gas oil was up $1.75 with resistance holding at $167.
Traders said there was some active spread play as funds rolled positions forward with the Aug/Sep spread traded at +4 cents, up from -20 cents last week.

The market's underlying strength was initially provided by the deferral of Iraqi oil sales from July to August, but though the gains have put several fresh technical supports in place many analysts were still looking for confirmation of the market's recent gains.
"The market looks bullish in the short term. But unless it can get up to $19 the chances are we may see it pulling back sharply again," Independent analysts Elli Gifford said.

Analysts said a supportive gap-up on the spot Brent chart between $18.18 Friday's close and $18.34 a barrel Monday's opening remained intact while a bullish cross of the 10/20-day moving averages also pointed the market towards fresh upside targets.

They said the next short term target would then be $19 which marks a 50 percent Fibonacci retracement then in the longer term the congested period in the $19.20-70 region on the August chart could be a target although new contract highs above $20.50 could take some time to achieve.
Monday's price gains saw gas oil on spot month continuation chart in the middle of a third wave up, the previous two of which have peaked in the high $170s, $179.50 being the high of May 22.
However, analysts said Monday's narrow trading range of $1 could suggest some uncertainty as to the market's conviction to go higher.

Looking further out Elli Gifford said "$165.75 (on the August chart)from Friday's gap up is critical support, but a lot of resistance will be met around $167.25 which is the top of the gap down earlier this month".
